statement: (i) For every s ≥ 1, after choosing an identification of a height-s Lubin–Tate special fiber with Γs, there is a natural isomorphism of Qp-vector space sheaves Hs ∼ = B(Es). In particular, its value at Spa(C, OC) identifies Γs(mC) with H0(XC, Es). (ii) For vector bundles V, W on XC with nonnegative Harder–Narasimhan slopes, the natural map HomXC (V, W) −→ HomShAb(PerfC ) B(V), B(W)  is an isomorphism. Thus every additive sheaf morphism between these section sheaves is induced by a unique bundle morphism.
